fusions.name: Firm Rein Charge
fusions.desc: A guided charge at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Grip and Kick
fusions.desc: Grips the target and kicks, dealing 5 damage and leaving it 4% easier to wound for 2 seconds, with a 15% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Leg Up
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Light on the Reins
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
